concept.title: Community transport and mobility equipment
concept.shortdesc: Getting around through community rides and transport, and hiring, loaning or buying mobility equipment.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Door-to-door transport, dial-a-ride, shuttle buses and volunteer car rides to appointments, shops and social outings.
: Hiring, loaning or buying wheelchairs, mobility scooters, wheelchair accessible vehicles and other mobility equipment.
